why.text: In the 2021 International Comparison Program, India had the lowest price level among 21 Asia-Pacific economies for investment goods, which include construction. The same work usually costs more in Southeast Asia.

source.label: Asian Development Bank, ICP 2021 results for India

prices.what: Solar-reflective roof paint, and a modular cool roof for a one-room home
prices.figure: About ₹25 per sq ft (≈US$2.80 per m²) for paint; about ₹27,000 (≈US$280) for a 9 m² modular roof lasting 25 years
prices.result: Reflective paint kept homes 2–5 °C cooler indoors than ordinary roofs.

sources.label: NRDC: community-led cool roofs in four Indian cities

prices.figure: A 40 kg set sold for Rp 2.73 million covers 120–160 m²: roughly Rp 17,000–23,000 per m² (≈US$1–1.50) by our arithmetic. Given free to schools and places of worship.

sources.label: The Thaiger: Indonesia adopts cool roofs

prices.figure: About ₱500–1,200 per m² (≈US$9–21), an industry estimate that its authors call a barrier for households earning about ₱25,000 a month

sources.label: Ken Research: Philippines cool roof market

prices.what: Cool paint on public housing blocks
prices.figure: Being rolled out to every HDB estate by 2030, at an extra cost of about S$60 million
prices.result: Trials aimed to lower the air temperature around blocks by up to 2 °C.

returns.text: A World Bank cost-benefit study of Lucknow, Chennai and Surat found that heat-health early warning systems return more than 50 times their cost, and urban greening about three times, counting health and work alone.

source.label: Jones et al., World Bank Policy Research Working Paper 10960, 2024
